hunks.sol: “…You look stranger to me. And swallow what’s in your mouth before you talk.”

hunks.sol: *How long is that guy going to chew those dumplings? Does he have a bottomless pot that keeps producing them?*

hunks.sol: A translucent holographic window suddenly rose above his snow-white hair.

hunks.baseline: “He just seems like a false lead—”

hunks.baseline: One of them was merely so-so, but the other two…
hunks.sol: One of them was merely so-so, but the other two… Honestly, he was impressed.

hunks.baseline: Honestly, they were impressive.
The one noisily chewing dumplings in front of an elder, especially, had already reached a fully mature Peak realm. It would not be an exaggeration to say so.
hunks.sol: The one rudely smacking away on dumplings in front of an elder, especially, had reached a fully seasoned Peak realm. It would not be an exaggeration to say so.

hunks.baseline: *Would only the Elders of the Nine Sects and One Gang whom I crossed paths with briefly in the past be able to compare?*
hunks.sol: *Only the Elders of the Nine Sects and One Gang he had crossed paths with a few times in the past could compare.*

hunks.baseline: The other one was tall and broad-shouldered.
hunks.sol: On the other hand, the other one was tall and broad-shouldered…

hunks.sol: *L-Look at the way that bastard opens his eyes so rudely. I ought to just gouge them out.*
